campaign: PCB-S1 — route the flight board under ONE rule set at $0

rule_params.hole_size_scope: vias only (condition A.Type == 'Via'); PTH pad drills are library-defined and JLCPCB-legal down to 0.2mm

router_inputs_derived_from.note: routers are told exactly what the referee enforces: KRT gets --clearance 0.2 --track-width 0.2 --via-size 0.6 --via-drill 0.3; Specctra DSN carries the same numbers from the same netclass

dru_mechanism_verified.how: kicad-cli resolves custom rules from <board-basename>.kicad_dru next to the .kicad_pcb (project = sibling .kicad_pro)
dru_mechanism_verified.probe: temporary rule (constraint clearance (min 3.0mm)) on the placed board: 4 violations -> 165 violations (161 clearance); with the frozen rules: 4 cosmetic silk_edge_clearance only
dru_mechanism_verified.scoping_fix: a GLOBAL hole_size (min 0.3mm) rule flags the 12 library PTH pads drilled at 0.20mm as drill_out_of_range — a rule-scoping artifact, not a board defect; the frozen file scopes it to vias

per_attempt_rule_application: each attempt board gets byte-identical copies of the frozen .kicad_dru (and the frozen .kicad_pro) as its siblings, verified by sha256 before scoring
